name: Daniela Londoño
tagline: Dueña de Londoño Salón, Medellín. 30 años. Emprendedora, perfeccionista y cercana — la cara de su propia marca.

identity_lock.apparent_age: 30 years old — a settled adult face, not a smoothed twenty-something: faint expression lines at the outer corners of the eyes when she smiles, and a fully developed jaw and cheek structure
identity_lock.heritage: Colombian, from Medellín — warm-toned mestiza features

skin.texture: healthy and well cared for but real — visible pores across the nose and inner cheeks, a faint natural flush across the cheekbones, soft natural sheen on the high points rather than a highlighter shine, no smoothing

hair.colour: dark espresso-brown base with a strong warm caramel and honey balayage that begins around cheekbone height and brightens toward the ends — a professionally coloured, expensive-looking blend, never a flat block colour
hair.texture: thick, glossy, loose beachy waves with an S-bend through the mid-lengths and softer ends; healthy movement rather than a rigid curl
hair.length: long — falling to mid-chest, well below the collarbone
hair.default_styling: centre-to-slightly-off-centre part, worn down and swept behind one shoulder so the caramel face-framing pieces sit forward around her face

eyes.colour: dark brown, warm, with a soft catchlight
eyes.shape: almond, medium-set, gently upturned at the outer corner, natural lashes with mascara
eyes.brows: thick, full and naturally dense with a soft low arch, groomed and brushed up, noticeably dark against her skin; the left brow sits marginally higher than the right

face.shape: soft oval with full cheeks — width through the mid-face, tapering to a rounded chin
face.cheekbones: high and full, rounded rather than sculpted, with soft fullness underneath
face.nose: straight medium-width bridge, slightly rounded tip, narrow nostrils
face.mouth: full lips, balanced upper and lower, well-defined cupid's bow, natural rosy-nude colour with a soft sheen
face.jaw_chin: soft, clean jawline without a sharp angle; small rounded chin, no cleft

distinguishing_marks: the caramel balayage that starts at cheekbone height and frames her face — her single strongest recognition cue at any distance
thick, dark, naturally full brows with a low soft arch, the left one sitting marginally higher than the right
full cheeks that round out visibly when she smiles, lifting the lower eyelid

body.build: medium and healthy with softly toned bare arms — a real body, not a slim-model frame
body.posture: relaxed and open, shoulders down and back, head often tilted slightly to one side when she is listening
body.hands: well-kept hands with short almond nails in a nude gloss, a fine gold ring, a slim dark-strap watch on the left wrist

identity_lock.grooming: polished everyday makeup, the way a beauty professional actually wears it — brows filled and brushed up, warm neutral bronze on the lids, mascara, soft cream blush high on the cheek, and a nude-rose lip with a light sheen. Skin looks like good skin, not like a filter: no heavy contouring, no strobe highlighter, no false lashes, no sharp cut crease.
must_not: when a master reference is attached, the reference is authoritative for facial detail — do not add moles, scars or marks that are not visible in it
do not shorten the hair, straighten it flat, or remove the caramel balayage
do not slim the face or sharpen the jawline — the full cheeks are part of who she is
do not lighten the skin tone or cool the golden undertone
do not thin, arch or over-shape the brows
do not add heavy glamour makeup, cut crease, false lashes or strobe highlighter
do not render her as a fashion model — she is a working salon owner who is comfortable on camera
do not make her younger than 29 or older than 34
do not add tattoos, or piercings beyond a single small lobe piercing per ear
identity_lock.distinct_from: Daniela Londoño is the woman in the attached master reference — that photograph defines her likeness. She is deliberately NOT the earlier reference woman this project started from; if any other source image is supplied, use it only for lighting, mood and wardrobe language, never for facial likeness.

persona.profession: Dueña de salón de belleza y peluquera
persona.business: Londoño Salón — su propio espacio, abierto hace 5 años, con un equipo pequeño
persona.context: Daniela siempre supo que su pasión era la belleza y el servicio al cliente. Empezó trabajando en un salón mientras estudiaba y hace cinco años decidió emprender y abrir su propio espacio. Hoy lidera un equipo, atiende a sus clientas habituales, se sigue capacitando en tendencias y técnicas, y produce ella misma el contenido de la marca entre cita y cita.
persona.energy: Emprendedora, perfeccionista, creativa y cercana. Habla con las manos, escucha con la cabeza ligeramente inclinada, y en cámara se ve cómoda porque lleva años haciéndolo — no porque esté actuando.
persona.goal: Hacer crecer su salón, fidelizar clientas y posicionar su marca como referente de belleza en la ciudad.
represents: Pasión por realzar la belleza de cada mujer

style.wardrobe_base: a fitted black sleeveless knit top with a straight neckline, and ivory high-waisted pleated trousers with a black leather belt and a gold buckle
style.wardrobe_offduty: a cream ribbed knit top and straight dark denim, the same gold jewellery
style.accessories: two layered fine gold chains, the shorter one carrying a small round pendant that sits at the collarbone; small thin gold hoops; a slim dark-strap watch on the left wrist; short almond nails in a nude gloss
style.palette: black, ivory and cream, warm gold hardware, dark charcoal and warm wood from the salon
style.identity_backdrop: seamless mid-grey studio paper, evenly lit, two stops darker than the subject
environments: Londoño Salón, main floor: charcoal walls, warm wood counters, black leather styling chairs, arched mirrors edged with warm LED strips, trailing pothos and a large potted monstera, exposed pendant bulbs, and a warm-white neon sign reading GOOD HAIR GOOD MOOD GOOD DAY on the dark wall
the salon's retail wall: backlit shelves of amber and clear product bottles against dark stone, warm downlight
her back-office corner at the end of the salon: dark stone counter, open laptop, leather notebook, a single warm downlight
the street entrance: a pale concrete facade with a full-height glass door and LONDOÑO SALÓN etched in thin capitals, clipped shrubs either side, soft overcast daylight
a Medellín café with a large window, pale wood table and morning light — where she is photographed off duty

realism.extra_notes: Two failure modes to watch with this colouring and this room. First the grade: her skin is already warm and the salon is full of tungsten practicals, so grade neutral and let the warmth come from the light, never from the white balance — otherwise she renders orange. Second the hair: the caramel balayage is the thing models most often flatten into a single brown. Keep the dark root, the warm mid-length and the brighter ends distinct.
